title.value:
Head2Toe: Utilizing Intermediate Representations

title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Head2Toe: Utilizing Intermediate Representations
for Better Transfer Learning

extractions.description: The paper introduces Head2Toe, a transfer learning method that selects features from all layers of a source model to train a classification head for a target domain. It matches or outperforms fine-tuning on VTAB while reducing training and storage costs.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving transfer learning techniques, not directly on sustainable development themes.

formance in a data-scarce target domain using a
model pretrained on a data-rich source domain.
